ctx.x: Well, as soon as they took Jay off of that bandstand, Johnny Tunno and somebody from that office, RKO or Rockwell (unintelligible) who it was, O'Keefe or who it was, they came and said, well, listen, we have decided that we're taking too much of a chance in doing it this way, until Jay gets back this is going to be Walter Brown and his band, under the direction of Gene Ramey.

So I told them, I said, under those circumstances, you'll have Walter Brown and his band, because Gene Ramey is not going. I said, I'm sorry I got to give you this on a short notice, because we were supposed to be in Cincinnati the next night. I said, I'm sorry to tell you that I am not going.
